Use case: ui-mockup, targeted revision of an existing Chinese desktop editor UI design, a static high fidelity PNG.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Redesign it according to this user's corrections: main editor has a SINGLE LEFT NAVIGATION AREA, default NO RIGHT SIDEBAR. Every existing capability remains reachable. This is a professional working application, not a marketing illustration.
Keep Long编辑 brand, Windows titlebar, familiar left rail and library navigator together as one left navigation zone, document tabs, breadcrumb, toolbar, footer. Remove the ENTIRE right reference/navigation pane in the supplied image, including all right 参考/大纲/关系/历史 tabs. Expand the writing surface to occupy the space. Render a full 16:9 app screenshot, no device frame, no annotation arrows.
Theme example is the actual existing '专业浅色' + '极简': background #f7f8fa, surface #ffffff, text #171a1f, accent #2563eb. ALL shell areas INCLUDING FAR LEFT GLOBAL RAIL must use this light theme, no permanent charcoal rail, no teal accent. Small 4–6px radii, clear fine borders, minimal shadows, calm neutral surfaces with sparing blue active states, crisp readable Chinese sans.
Layout:
Far left slim rail, same light-neutral palette: Long编辑 small L mark, 工作台, 资料库 selected, 收集箱, 知识图谱, bottom 设置. No extra global history shortcut.
Left library navigator ~280px. '工作资料库' selector and navigation collapse button; '搜索文件与正文'; '+ 新建' dropdown and '新建文件夹' / '每日笔记'. Seven existing section selectors ONLY HERE: 文件、大纲、最近、智能集合、标签、关系、历史 arranged in two compact rows as in input. File tree with 项目资料, selected 项目方案.md, 调研报告.pdf, 预算.xlsx, 产品结构.canvas, 日常记录, 参考文献. At bottom small search/index ready status, Git 拉取 推送, file count. Avoid a duplicate 收集箱 shortcut at navigator bottom since rail already has it.
Top titlebar: search '搜索文件与命令 Ctrl+P', 快速笔记, 命令, window controls. Document tabs: 项目方案.md with modified indicator, 调研报告.pdf, 预算.xlsx.
Document action row: breadcrumb '项目资料 / 项目方案.md'; at right '参考' (outline icon, currently CLOSED), blue '保存', '文档操作' dropdown.
Formatting toolbar: undo redo, 标题1, B I, task/list/quote/link/image/code icons, 插入 dropdown, 更多格式 dropdown. All advanced actions remain in named menus. Footer: 未保存 · Ctrl+S, Markdown · 可编辑, UTF-8, LF, 1,248字, 行23 列1, 专注.
Main body is one generous writing area with a sensible readable ~850px text column and pleasant left/right whitespace; do NOT turn it into a second sidebar or dashboard. Preserve sample content and hierarchy: 项目方案; 把资料整理成可继续的工作; 本周重点 three checklist items; small quotation with subtle blue left border; 时间安排 five row table; 后续思考. Large clear body typography, enough realistic content visible without filler. No right navigation, no right information cards, no duplicated Outline/Relations/History. All seven left selectors stay intact.

Far left rail selected 资料库, working library selector, search/new controls and same file tree. Left zone width ~380px on this1672px canvas. Same 项目方案.md tabs/breadcrumb and 保存 / 文档操作; 参考 now blue subtly active. Same format controls 插入/更多格式. Preserve main document with 项目方案 / 本周重点 / checklist / quote / 时间安排 / 后续思考, footer 未保存 Ctrl+S / UTF-8 LF / 专注.
Right pane header only '参考资料' and close X. Second row source document '会议记录.md', subtle '刷新' and '更多' menu. A clear source excerpt card heading '项目计划' and readable 5-line Chinese source paragraph, subtle highlighted phrase 项目计划. Under excerpt: small real source position '来源位置 · 第18行', '在源文件中打开'. Bottom of source card buttons '复制摘要', '插入正文', '主区打开'; shorter wrapping rows permitted. Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a STATIC professional Chinese desktop app design comparison board for Long编辑. Landscape 16:9, six equally sized large mini-app screenshots in a clean 3 columns x 2 rows grid, with a concise title and one clear preset caption ABOVE each panel. Purpose: demonstrate the SAME SINGLE-LEFT-NAVIGATION editor layout in all SIX EXISTING UI SURFACE STYLES. Not merely six color tints: vary radii, outlines, gradients, elevation and whitespace according to each style. No device mockups, no marketing art, no perspective. Crisp legible typography, refined production software design.
Board title '同一布局，六种界面风格', subtitle '导航只在左侧 · 主题与动效继续由用户选择'.
Invariant in all panels: narrow global rail at far LEFT with 工作台/资料库/收集箱/知识图谱 and bottom 设置; next library navigator with 工作资料库, search, +新建, all seven small selector labels 文件/大纲/最近/智能集合/标签/关系/历史, tree 项目方案.md/调研报告.pdf/预算.xlsx; right two thirds is the DOCUMENT BODY ONLY, no right sidebar. Top tabs, document actions 参考 保存 文档操作, compact formatting row, footer. Same project proposal body title 项目方案, subheading 本周重点, 3 checklist lines, a small quote and small table. All controls occupy matching positions across the six panels. No visible duplicated navigation, do not omit the 7 selectors because of theme. Far left rail follows each theme; do not keep a dark rail in light themes.
Six panel captions and authentic style rules:
1 top-left '柔和 · 森林绿柔和' (style soft, tone green): #f2f7f2 background, #fbfdfb surface, #1b8a5a accent, #17211c text. 12px rounded panels, warm creamy gentle gradients, soft diffuse elevation. Readable, restful.
2 top-center '新拟态 · 科技蓝霓虹' (style neo, tone blue): #f1f6fb bg, #fbfdff surface, #0b73d9 accent, #142033 text. 4px small radii, precise technical accent outlines, subtle metallic light gradients and hard directional shadows/counter highlights, restrained neon focus. Existing neo is a tech aesthetic, not huge inflated squishy controls.
3 top-right '玻璃 · 樱粉玻璃' (style glass, tone pink): #fbf4f7 bg, #fffbfd surface, #cf3f72 accent, #2a1820 text. 14px rounded surfaces, transparent layered pink/white cards, thin highlight edges, crisp optical layering WITHOUT blur or illegible text. No background illustration.
4 bottom-left '呼吸 · 云白纸张' (style airy, tone white): #f7f8fa bg, white surfaces, #2563eb accent, #171a1f text. 10px rounded, paper-like generous whitespace, hairline borders, extremely light shadow. Same controls retained.
5 bottom-center '极简 · 专业深色' (style minimal, tone dark): #111316 bg, #181b20 surface, #f4f6f8 text, #64d987 accent. 6px radii, flat opaque charcoal surfaces, little decoration/shadow, clean separators, comfortable contrast. Entire app is dark.
6 bottom-right '锐利 · 高对比' (style sharp, tone contrast): pure black bg, #111111 surface, white text, #ffd400 yellow accent. 0–2px radii, strong visible outlines, square controls, solid opaque surfaces, decisive selected states, no soft glow/transparency/gray-on-gray text. High contrast must be legible.
Small board footer only '示例覆盖六类风格；保留全部 19 套预设、色调、代码高亮与四种动效节奏'. Do not suggest six examples replace the other presets. This is a design proposal screenshot, not evidence of deployed functionality.
